build_improved_transformer: build an ImprovedTransformer model with configurable qkv_size, num_heads, mlp_size, and num_layers for multi-layer attention
create_transformer_block: create an ImprovedTransformerBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and MLP using RMSNorm normalization
create_multihead_attention: create an ImprovedMHDPAttention module with normalized queries and keys for multi-head dot-product attention
run_attention_with_masks: run attention with optional qq_mask and qk_mask for self-attention and cross-attention masking
test_attention_normalization: test ImprovedMHDPAttention with RMSNorm normalization on queries and keys before dot-product attention
